bagPolicy.summary: BC Place permits small opaque bags no larger than 6.5 by 8.5 inches and clear plastic bags no larger than 12 by 12 by 6 inches. All bags are searched.
allowed: Opaque bags no larger than 6.5 by 8.5 inches
Clear plastic bags no larger than 12 by 12 by 6 inches
Diaper bags and medically necessary items, subject to inspection
prohibited: Non-clear bags larger than 6.5 by 8.5 inches
Clear bags larger than 12 by 12 by 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: FIFA World Cup 2026 events may use a different event-specific policy.

parking.note: Parking near BC Place ranges from $10 to $30 during events. Limited accessible parking is available, with a dedicated drop-off area for mobility devices at Gate F on Pacific Boulevard.

rideshare.note: For accessible pickup and drop-off, use the entrance below Gate F on Pacific Boulevard, across from Plaza of Nations. This is the 147 Accessible Entrance. No parking is allowed there.

concessions.note: Food and drinks are sold inside, including gluten-free and plant-based options. Outside food and drinks are prohibited. For infant or medical exceptions, contact stadium@bcpavco.com or 604-661-3401 before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: BC Place's accessible drop-off and pick-up area is located at section 147, just off Pacific Blvd across from Plaza of Nations. Sensory bags containing fidget tools and noise-cancelling headphones are available, until supplies last, for checkout at no cost by leaving an ID at our any Guest Services Desk locations (Section 234 and Section 446) in the Stadium.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For most events, including concerts, there are no in/out privileges, so once you leave you can't re-enter. Some special events set their own policies, so check the event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Have your tickets ready before you reach the gate. At the turnstile, scan barcode tickets below the screen or tap mobile wallet tickets at the top. Re-download mobile tickets before arriving so the latest gate info shows.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: All entrances are accessible. For barrier-free drop-off and pick-up, use the 147 Accessible Entrance off Pacific Blvd, below Gate F across from Plaza of Nations. When your ticket lists a gate, enter there, and re-download mobile tickets before arriving for the latest gate info.
